## Architectural Specializations
### 1. Streaming Data Lakehouses
- High throughput event ingestion: 10M+ events/day using Redpanda and Apache Kafka.
- Stateful stream processing: Apache Flink with checkpointing, watermark tracking, and dead-letter queues.
- Lakehouse storage: Apache Iceberg on MinIO/S3 with versioned catalog (Project Nessie) for atomic commits and time-travel rollback queries.
- Distributed querying: Trino distributed SQL engine for low-latency ad-hoc and dashboard analytics.

### 2. Conversational Voice AI & 3D Avatars
- Low-latency telephony: Twilio Media Streams integrated with Pipecat orchestration.
- Audio streaming: WebRTC and UDP audio pipes maintaining sub-500ms voice round-trip latency.
- Real-time LLM inference: Azure OpenAI and open weights with conversational barge-in and turn-taking.
- CRM Integration: Automatic sentiment classification, objection logging, call scoring, and pipeline stage updates.
- Visual interaction: 3D avatars with synchronized lip-sync and audio visualizers for sales and ERP backoffice navigation.

### 3. Document AI & Financial Intelligence
- Invoice AI: Complex multi-page PDF document parsing, HSN code validation, and tax variance detection.
- Vector similarity: pgvector and Pinecone embedding search to reconcile discrepancies between purchase order lines and supplier invoice descriptions.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
### Q: What do you build?
A: I build AI-powered software: LLM and RAG applications, voice AI agents, 3D avatar assistants, real-time data pipelines and full-stack enterprise platforms.

### Q: Which technologies do you work with?
A: AI and LLM work with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI and Llama; Django, FastAPI, Node.js and Laravel on the backend; Angular, React and Vue on the frontend; Redpanda, Flink, Spark, Iceberg and Trino for data; and Docker with GitHub Actions for delivery.

### Q: Can you build a voice AI agent for sales calls?
A: Yes. I have built calling bots with Twilio, Pipecat and an LLM that hold natural conversations, detect sentiment, score calls and update the CRM automatically.

### Q: What is a 3D avatar assistant?
A: It is a talking 3D character that customers or admins speak to. A customer-facing avatar answers product questions, captures leads and books appointments. An admin avatar fetches invoices, purchase orders, inventory, quotations and sales data.

### Q: Can you build a real-time data platform?
A: Yes. I design streaming pipelines and lakehouses with Redpanda, Flink, Iceberg and Trino, including versioned tables and time-travel queries.

### Q: Do you build multi-tenant SaaS products?
A: Yes. I have delivered multi-tenant platforms with role-based access, microservices, API gateways and observability.

### Q: Do you have live products I can try?
A: Yes. I have launched three live platforms: Grahavani (Vedic astrology in six Indian languages with Swiss Ephemeris calculations), PulseWire (a real-time global newsroom and market intelligence PWA), and Rankdesk (a free 24-point SEO audit toolkit).

### Q: How do I start a project with you?
A: Send an email or WhatsApp message through the Contact page with a short description of what you need. We can then discuss scope, timeline and next steps.

### Q: Where are you based?
A: I am based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
